_comment: #2301 grandfathered HIGH/CRITICAL npm advisories. Each entry needs a written `reason`. The guard FAILS on any advisory not listed here and hints when an entry goes stale (prune it). Regenerate preserving reasons: npm audit --audit-level=high --json | node scripts/check-audit-baseline.mjs --update

entries.title: Socket.IO: Engine.IO Protocol Revision Mismatch DoS
entries.reason: engine.io 6.6.9 (installed) via devDependency socket.io; advisory is a protocol-revision-mismatch DoS against the dev realtime server. Fix arrives with a socket.io/engine.io 6.6.10 refresh in a dedicated dependency PR. Accepted as transient until then.

entries.title: fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via an unclosed bracket in the URI authority
entries.reason: fast-uri 3.1.6 (installed; pinned via package.json overrides ^3.1.6) — host-confusion in parse. Only reached through ajv schema URL resolution with trusted internal schemas, no attacker-controlled URIs in current call paths. Fix: bump override to ^3.1.9 in the scheduled dependency-refresh PR.

entries.title: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion in parseCommaParts causing stack exhaustion
entries.reason: brace-expansion 5.0.9 installed ONLY in nested dev toolchain trees (eslint/typescript-eslint minimatch glob parsing). Build-time DoS; the runtime copy is already forced to safe 2.1.x via package.json overrides. Fix lands when the lint toolchain refreshes minimatch.

entries.title: shell-quote: `quote()` command injection via a line terminator in a token after a `{ comment }` token
entries.reason: shell-quote 1.9.0, reached only through devDependency concurrently@10.0.5, which pins it exactly ("shell-quote": "1.9.0"). The first unaffected release is 1.11.0, so the only in-tree fixes are overriding a dependency's deliberate exact pin or the semver-major downgrade npm itself proposes (concurrently 9.2.1, whose tree still resolves into the affected range). quote() here serialises developer-written npm scripts; no request data, upload or header ever reaches it, in CI or in the product. Accepted as transient — prune when concurrently moves off the 1.9.0 pin.

entries.title: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups causing stack exhaustion
entries.reason: brace-expansion 5.0.9 nested dev-toolchain copies (same tree as GHSA-6J4F-FJ2G-MC7P). Build-time DoS only; runtime override already pins 2.1.x. Follows the same lint-toolchain refresh.

entries.title: fast-uri vulnerable to authority injection via an unvalidated port in serialize
entries.reason: fast-uri 3.1.6 authority-injection in serialize. Same reachability as GHSA-58MR-GQGX-XQ4G (ajv internal schema resolution, trusted inputs). Fix: override bump to >=3.1.8 in the scheduled dependency-refresh PR.

entries.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
entries.reason: braces 3.0.3 transitive of tailwindcss 3.4.19/chokidar/micromatch (dev build toolchain only). Only listed fix is the tailwindcss 4.3.3 semver-major, which is a separate tracked upgrade. Build-time DoS; no server-runtime exposure.
